name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/gaia2-cli/cli/gaia2_cli/daemon/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.create_filechanneladapter: create a FileChannelAdapter instance with notifications, responses, and events JSONL file paths
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.send_response: send an agent response string that appends to agent_responses.jsonl and events.jsonl
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.read_notifications: read new notifications from notifications.jsonl since the last read offset
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.wait_for_notification: block and poll for new notifications with a configurable interval and timeout
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_filechanneladapter: review the FileChannelAdapter class for file-based daemon to agent communication patterns

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.execute_cli_action: execute an ENV action via CLI subprocess and return stdout or error result
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_cli_cmd: build a CLI command list from an app name, function name, and arguments dictionary
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_cli: run a CLI command as a subprocess with optional event ID and state directory
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.get_flag_params: get the set of Click flag option names for a given CLI subcommand
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.refactor_execute_cli_action: refactor execute_cli_action to support custom timeout values for subprocess execution

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_gaia2_event_daemon: run the Gaia2 event daemon to watch events.jsonl for agent actions and fire ENV reactions
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_daemon_with_judge: run the Gaia2 event daemon with an LLM judge model for multi-turn scenario grading
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_daemon_docker_mode: run the Gaia2 event daemon in Docker mode with a notify URL for HTTP-based notifications
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_Gaia2EventDaemon_class: review the Gaia2EventDaemon class that polls events.jsonl, detects turn boundaries, and executes ENV actions
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_main_cli_entry: review the Click CLI entry point that configures and starts the Gaia2 event daemon with options

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_replay_scenario: run a single Gaia2 scenario replay by calling CLI tools for each oracle turn with optional daemon support
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_replay_scenario_batch: run all scenario JSON files in a directory through the replay pipeline with daemon and verbose logging
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.load_scenario_events: load and parse a Gaia2 scenario JSON file to extract oracle agent events grouped by turn using topological sort
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.load_scenario_events_via_env: load a Gaia2 scenario using ScenarioLoader and EventProcessor for correct DAG-based turn assignment matching the judge
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.resolve_placeholders: resolve double-brace event_id placeholders in function arguments by looking up return values from previously executed events
